title: Circulating Tumor DNA in Patients at High Risk for Lung Cancer
brief_summary: Patients who are about to undergo a diagnostic or therapeutic bronchoscopy or thoracic surgery without a distant history of cancer will have their blood drawn for measurement of circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) to validate the utility of molecular diagnostic assays for the early detection of lung cancer.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years of age or older, not previously diagnosed with cancer (except for basal cell carcinomas of the skin or a diagnosis of cancer within a month of surgery and for which the surgical procedure is being performed).

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior history of cancer.
study_population: All patients scheduled to undergo a diagnostic or therapeutic bronchoscopy or thoracotomy by Dr. Robert McKenna.
condition: Non Small Cell Carcinoma of the Lung
Small Cell Carcinoma of the Lung
